lift_params_in_outer_transform: use hk.lift to register inner transform parameters in an outer Haiku transform for ensemble or vmap patterns
lift_with_state_params_and_state: use hk.lift_with_state to register both parameters and state from an inner transform in an outer transform
transparent_lift_without_namespace: use hk.transparent_lift to register inner transform parameters in an outer transform without adding a name scope
transparent_lift_with_state_without_name: use hk.transparent_lift_with_state to register params and state in an outer transform without adding a name scope
review_LiftingModule_call_behavior: review the LiftingModule class __call__ method to understand how it packs params during init and unpacks during apply
